subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His approach was filled with such __perseverance__ that it was difficult to overlook his merit.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Doggedness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"perseverance"** means persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. (दृढ़ता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her perseverance in completing the project was commendable.
 
 
 
• **"Doggedness" **refers to the quality of being determined to achieve something despite difficulties. (हठधर्मिता)
 
 
• **Example: **His doggedness in pursuing his goals has always been an inspiration to his peers.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Doggedness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignorance** (अज्ञानता): Lack of knowledge or information.

 
 
• **Example: **His ignorance of the local laws caused him a lot of trouble.
 
 
 
• **Reluctance** (अनिच्छा): Unwillingness or disinclination to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **She showed reluctance to join the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Monotonous** (नीरस): Dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest.
 
 
• **Example: **His job became monotonous over the years, leading him to look for new opportunities.
